items.t: Front strut upper mounts can break loose (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check the VIN to see whether it was done.

items.t: Fuel tank can be punctured in a rear crash (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check the VIN to see whether it was done.

items.t: Front lower ball joint can separate
items.job: Replace front lower ball joint or control arm (one side)
items.note: An alignment is usually needed afterward.

items.t: Cooling fan or its bracket breaks and damages the radiator
items.job: Replace radiator, cooling fan and fan bracket
items.note: A damaged A/C compressor or condenser adds a lot more.

items.t: Engine stalls when slowing down or turning
items.job: Replace ignition coil or distributor (if testing points to it)
items.note: Get it diagnosed first. Idle control or sensor faults cost differently.
Front driveshafts on 4WD models cost the most. Differential gear repair costs more.
Check for bent valves if the engine ran badly after the belt jumped.

items.t: Clutch pedal very stiff or drops to the floor
items.job: Repair or replace clutch pedal pivot or slave cylinder
items.note: Suzuki made a revised clutch pedal part for the broken weld.

items.t: Check engine light with random codes
items.note: Ask about bulletin SW02B before replacing parts.
